description:
## Goal

Replace web-console's built-in audio implementation with consumption of the shared audio-tools scenario. This should significantly reduce code in web-console while maintaining all current functionality.

## Scope

### Remove from web-console
- Voice streaming backend: `voice_stream_ws.go`, `voice_transcribe.go`, `voice_config.go`
- TTS backend: `tts_synthesize.go`, `tts_cache.go`, `tts_chunker.go`, `tts_normalizer.go`, `tts_summarizer.go`, `tts_summarize_config.go`, `tts_playback.go`, `tts_hook_handler.go`, `tts_config.go`, `tts_voices.go`
- Audio transcoding: `audio_transcode.go`
- Frontend hooks: `useVoiceInput.ts`, `useTextToSpeech.ts`, `voice/` subdirectory, `tts/` subdirectory
- Frontend components: `VoiceMicButton.tsx`, `AudioPlayerBar.tsx`, `VoiceCommandSuggestion.tsx`
- Settings components: `VoiceInputSection.tsx`, `TtsSettingsSection.tsx`

### Replace with
- API calls to audio-tools service endpoints
- Adopted UI components from audio-tools
- Thin integration layer in web-console for:
  - Hook handler (`tts_hook_handler.go` equivalent) — routing agent responses to audio-tools TTS
  - Conversation event updates with audio status
  - Configuration pass-through to audio-tools

### Preserve
- Voice command system (may stay in web-console as it's app-specific)
- Conversation event tracking and storage
- Auto-TTS trigger logic on tab switch

## Success Criteria

- All existing audio features work identically from the user's perspective
- Web-console audio code reduced by ~70%+
- Audio-tools is the single source of truth for audio capabilities
- Existing web-console audio tests pass (rewritten against audio-tools APIs)
name: web-console-adopt-audio-tools
title: Rewrite Web-Console Audio to Consume the Shared Audio-Tools Scenario
